completeness.why: Four sites now pass their raw amount to the existing getScheduledAmount, which decides missing/number/range; runSchedule in schedule-template.ts was not touched and keeps its own op-based halve-the-rounded-sum computation, so the one preserved rounding inconsistency was left at the site instead of being carried as an explicit argument.

interface.why: Reuses the existing exported getScheduledAmount(amount, inverse) unchanged, with no speculative options; the template's different rounding is not made explicit as a parameter but left out of the refactor.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline ternaries were removed and replaced with calls; the remaining template copy is left as it was, not reshaped.
